children.label: File metadata
children.description: Columns from the file-system scan: paths, sizes, extensions and timestamps.

children.label: Image metadata
children.description: Image properties the loaders extract into the shared raster-image schema.

children.label: Derived metadata
children.description: Columns the pipeline computes from image data: ndim and num_pixels are derived from dim_order and shape; size_<axis> columns are extracted from the actual array shape per dimension.

children.label: Aggregation
children.description: Columns added when per-image rows are rolled up into the obs hierarchy (obs_level, per-dimension coordinates).

children.label: nodata-statistics
children.description: Counts pixels matching the declared nodata value.

children.label: raster-basic
children.description: Computes basic per-image intensity statistics (min, max, mean, std) and the finite-pixel count, aggregated across chunks and dimensions.

children.label: raster-histogram
children.description: Computes a per-image intensity histogram, merging per-chunk histograms onto a shared value range.

children.label: raster-quality
children.description: Computes no-reference image quality metrics (sharpness, noise, spectral characteristics, clipping) over the 2D spatial extent of each image.

children.label: thumbnail
children.description: Generates a small downsampled RGBA thumbnail of each image, assembled from per-chunk spatial patches.

columns.name: common_base
columns.description: Name of the longest path prefix shared by all import bases.

columns.name: depth
columns.description: Depth of the path below the imported base directory.

columns.name: file_extension
columns.description: Lower-cased file extension without the leading dot.

columns.name: imported_path
columns.description: Path of the import base (the -p path or base directory) under which this file was found, relative to the project base directory ('.' when no -p paths were specified).

columns.name: imported_path_short
columns.description: Shortened, disambiguated label for the import base (only when several -p paths were used).

columns.name: modification_date
columns.description: Last modification timestamp of the file.

columns.name: name
columns.description: File or folder name, including extension.

columns.name: parent

columns.name: path
columns.description: Path of the file (or folder), relative to the project base directory.

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.description: Size on disk in bytes (aggregated for folders).

columns.name: type
columns.description: Row kind: 'file', 'folder', or 'sub_file' (a sub-image inside a container).

columns.name: longitude

columns.description: Physical pixel size along the given axis, in the image's spatial unit.

columns.name: ndim
columns.description: Number of image dimensions, derived from dim_order.

columns.name: num_pixels
columns.description: Number of pixels in this row's spatial extent (full image at obs_level=0, slice at higher levels).

columns.name: size_<axis>
columns.description: Extent (number of elements) of this row along the given axis.

columns.name: dim_<axis>
columns.description: Coordinate of this row along the given axis (e.g. dim_z = Z index); null when the row spans the whole axis.

columns.name: obs_level
columns.description: Aggregation level of the row: 0 is the whole-image summary; higher levels are per-dimension breakdowns.

columns.name: bright_clipping_fraction
columns.description: Fraction of pixels at this image's own observed maximum value (all dtypes). Detects bright-end clipping regardless of storage format or bit depth.

columns.name: dark_clipping_fraction
columns.description: Fraction of pixels at the dtype's minimum representable value (integer types only; NaN for float). Indicates underexposure, background, or nodata.

columns.name: finite_pixel_count
columns.description: Number of finite (non-NaN/Inf) pixels contributing to the statistics.

columns.name: histogram_counts
columns.description: Per-bin pixel counts over the histogram value range (fixed number of bins; integer data uses one-level-wide bins).

columns.name: histogram_max
columns.description: Upper bound of the histogram's value range.

columns.name: histogram_min
columns.description: Lower bound of the histogram's value range.

columns.name: histogram_nan_count
columns.description: Number of NaN pixels excluded from the histogram.

columns.name: laplacian_variance
columns.description: High-frequency content measure. Low values indicate blur or heavy compression. High values are ambiguous (noise, quantization artifacts, and genuine sharpness all produce high scores). Inflated by clipping boundaries.

columns.name: max_intensity
columns.description: Maximum pixel intensity over the covered extent (ignoring NaNs).

columns.name: mean_intensity
columns.description: Pixel-count-weighted mean intensity over the covered extent.

columns.name: min_intensity
columns.description: Minimum pixel intensity over the covered extent (ignoring NaNs).

columns.name: nodata_count
columns.description: Number of pixels equal to the declared nodata value.

columns.name: noise_mad
columns.description: Noise standard deviation via Haar wavelet MAD estimator (Donoho & Johnstone 1994). Robust to image texture. Anscombe-transformed for integer dtypes to handle Poisson noise.

columns.name: spectral_slope
columns.description: Log-log slope of the radially averaged power spectrum (mid-frequency band). Blur steepens the slope (more negative); noise flattens it (toward zero). The only metric that maps blur and noise to opposite directions.

columns.name: std_intensity
columns.description: Pooled standard deviation of intensity over the covered extent.

columns.name: thumbnail
columns.description: Raw RGBA bytes of the assembled thumbnail sprite (fixed sprite size).

columns.name: thumbnail_dtype
columns.description: Original pixel dtype of the source image the thumbnail was built from.

columns.name: thumbnail_norm_max
columns.description: Upper intensity bound used to normalize the thumbnail.

columns.name: thumbnail_norm_min
columns.description: Lower intensity bound used to normalize the thumbnail.

widgets.label: Dimensionality
widgets.info:
Shows how **image dimension sizes** (e.g. X, Y, Z, T, …) vary across the dataset.

Includes an X/Y size scatter plot and per-dimension strip plots.

If a dimension has **no variance**, it is summarized in a table instead of a plot.

Use this to identify **unexpected dimension sizes** and **mismatched shapes** within/between groupings.

widgets.label: File Statistics
widgets.info:
High-level **file statistics** for the dataset.

If a property has **no variance** (e.g. all files share the same extension), it is summarized in the table instead of a chart.

widgets.label: Pixel Value Histograms
widgets.info:
Histograms are computed per image (256 bins) and averaged per group.
Each image is area-normalized before averaging, so image size does not affect the result.

If the dataset mixes unsigned integer, signed integer, and/or floating-point images, each kind gets its own plot.

**Display mode** (integer panels only)
- **Actual values** – x-axis shows real pixel values.
- **Dtype range** – x-axis normalized to the representable range of the pixel type (unsigned integers: 0 to 1, signed integers: -1 to 1). Useful for comparing images across bit depths.

Float images always show actual values.

**Spread** – shaded +/-1 std band around the group mean.
A wider band means more variation between images in that group.

**Show individual images** – visible when one group is selected with 50 or fewer images.
Replaces the group mean with one line per image.

widgets.label: Image Table
widgets.info: Full-image statistics — one row per image file, no per-slice or per-channel rows. Click a column header to sort. Search (Enter): substring match across all columns for small datasets, path and child_id only for large ones (≥10k images).

widgets.label: Metadata
widgets.info:
Shows the distribution of **pixel data types** and **dimension ordering** across groupings.

If a property has **no variance** (e.g. every file has the same pixel dtype), it is summarized in a table instead of a chart.

widgets.label: Image Thumbnails
widgets.info:
Displays a **thumbnail mosaic**, one thumbnail per file.

- Thumbnails are generated from the central slice in all non-XY, non-RGB dimensions.
- Sorting by a numeric column can reveal visual trends.
- Border colors indicate the group of each image.
- **Hover** over an image to see its filename.

widgets.label: NoData
widgets.info: NoData value frequency, nodata-pixel percentage, and non-finite pixels (float images).

widgets.label: Basic Statistics Across Dimensions
widgets.info:
Shows how image statistics (e.g., mean, std, min, max) change **across different dimension slices**.

Useful for identifying drift, artifacts, or unexpected variation.

The dashed line shows the **% of images that still have a slice at this position**, per condition - useful for spotting datasets where images have different numbers of slices.

widgets.label: Quality Metrics Across Dimensions
widgets.info:
Shows how **image quality metrics** change across different dimension slices.

Useful to detect e.g. drift in focus or noise over time (T) and depth (Z) as well as channel (C) specific artifacts.

The dashed line shows the **% of images that still have a slice at this position**, per condition.

widgets.label: File Data Summary
widgets.info: High-level overview of the dataset: total number of files and images, total size, file extensions, and (when grouped) a per-group breakdown.

widgets.label: File Structure Sunburst
widgets.info:
Sunburst view of the **file and folder hierarchy**.

Click a slice to zoom in; click the center to zoom out.

widgets.label: Pixel Value Statistics
widgets.info:
Shows **per-image intensity statistics** across groups.

Plots with 5,000 or fewer datapoints show the actual distribution shape (a violin); larger plots switch to a summary box plot (quartiles, min/max, mean).

Use the **Slice by** toggles to control whether each datapoint is a whole-image aggregate (**per image**) or one (image × dimension) combination (**per slice**) - shown by the badge in the card header. More toggles mean more datapoints, so check the sample size in the plot subtitle before trusting significance.

**Statistical Comparisons**

If selected (side menu), pairwise group comparisons use the Mann–Whitney U test (a non-parametric test that makes no assumptions about the data distribution) with Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.

Significance levels: `ns` not significant (p ≥ 0.05), `*` p < 0.05, `**` p < 0.01, `***` p < 0.001.

widgets.label: Image Quality Metrics
widgets.info:
Visualizes **image quality metrics** across groups.

Plots with 5,000 or fewer datapoints show the actual distribution shape (a violin); larger plots switch to a summary box plot (quartiles, min/max, mean).

Use the **Slice by** toggles to control whether each datapoint is a whole-image aggregate (**per image**) or one (image × dimension) combination (**per slice**) - shown by the badge in the card header. More toggles mean more datapoints, so check the sample size in the plot subtitle before trusting significance.

**Statistical Comparisons**

If selected (side menu), pairwise group comparisons use the Mann–Whitney U test (a non-parametric test that makes no assumptions about the data distribution) with Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.

Significance levels: `ns` not significant (p ≥ 0.05), `*` p < 0.05, `**` p < 0.01, `***` p < 0.001.
